title: Authorization bypass hidden by a DeMorgan-equivalent rewrite
description: Analyze a gate-level netlist of a permission-check cone ('perm_cone') restructured from AND/OR logic into NAND/NOR/inverter primitives during synthesis. Determine whether the restructured netlist is functionally equivalent to its documented reference behavior for all 32 combinations of req_level[1:0] and owner_id[2:0], and report any divergent input vector(s) together with the responsible gate instance(s).
expected_outputs: A single JSON report at submission/trojan_report.json stating whether the netlist diverges from the reference truth table (trojan_detected), which gate instance(s) in perm_cone_netlist.v are responsible for any divergence (suspect_instances), and the exact input vector(s) at which divergence occurs (diverging_vectors), each with the reference-expected grant value and the netlist-observed grant value, plus a free-form technical explanation.

metrics.name: detection_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of the true diverging input vector(s) and the true suspect gate instance(s) correctly identified in the submission, computed against ground truth obtained via exhaustive gate-level simulation.

metrics.name: false_positive_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of submitted diverging_vectors and suspect_instances that do not correspond to an actual divergence confirmed by exhaustive simulation of the netlist against the reference truth table.

metrics.name: schema_conformance
metrics.description: Binary/fractional score for whether submission/trojan_report.json satisfies the required JSON schema, field types, and value-format constraints.

metrics.name: inference_latency
metrics.description: Wall-clock time in seconds taken by the evaluator to grade the submitted report, including any optional iverilog/vvp/yosys cross-checks performed on the input artifacts.
